basic_profile.bio: I'm a 20-year-old college student from Portland, Oregon, studying pre-nursing. I’ve always been passionate about healthcare and love volunteering at local clinics. In my downtime, I enjoy playing Super Smash Bros. Ultimate and creating memes. I'm single and generally spend my evenings online, especially after 7 PM. I’m a vegetarian and love experimenting with new recipes, which is why I frequently visit the VeggieTalesMemes subreddit for both laughs and culinary inspiration.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Currently pursuing a degree in nursing, I have a solid foundation in healthcare basics. I'm also self-taught in meme culture and video gaming strategies, particularly Smash Ultimate. My interest in cooking and vegetarianism has led me to accumulate a considerable amount of knowledge in plant-based diets.
